scope: Proposition 6.2 of the manuscript “Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes” (preprints/Finite-Smith-Toda-Complexes-at-Varying-Primes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13dce3978089a78f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a positive integer C. For every odd prime p > C, every 0 ≤ k ≤ Cp, and every integer d, one has Symk (Sd ) ∈ Sp≥kd. If d is odd, there is the additional bound Symk (Sd ) ∈ Sp≥kd+k−(2C+1). (6.2) If d is even, the objects in Equation (6.1) satisfy Tp,k(d) ∈ Sp≥kd+2k−3C. (6.3) More precisely, writing k = lp + b with 0 ≤ b < p, an odd-degree extended power is contractible if b ≥ 2, and otherwise its cohomology above its rank begins no earlier than l(p − 2). For even d and k > 0, the multiplication cofiber is contractible if b > 0, and if b = 0 its cohomology above its rank begins no earlier than l(2p − 3).
